note: Unified, machine-readable harness catalog (SSOT). Classes x kinds x core-module maps x source. `tracked` cross-links an entry to data/sources.json by entity id. Prose explanation lives in review/harness-catalog.md; review/harness-index.md is generated from this file. The `instruments` class carries the scientific/formal evidence tools the discipline capabilities (formal-verification / dimensional-analysis / empirical-measurement) name; the claim->instrument map is reference/evidence-instruments.md.
licenses: Sources are cited (paper/repo/docs). Pricing/benchmark numbers, where any, are directional.

harnesses.name: CORE
harnesses.summary_en: Aggregator of open-access papers and repositories.
harnesses.summary_zh: 开放获取论文与仓储聚合器。

harnesses.name: Scite
harnesses.summary_en: Citation statements: how papers are supported or refuted.
harnesses.summary_zh: 引文陈述：论文被支持或反驳的情况。

harnesses.name: Litmaps
harnesses.summary_en: Citation-graph exploration to find connected literature.
harnesses.summary_zh: 引文图探索，寻找关联文献。

harnesses.name: Inciteful
harnesses.summary_en: Free citation-graph tool for literature mapping.
harnesses.summary_zh: 免费引文图工具，用于文献地图。

harnesses.name: LlamaIndex
harnesses.summary_en: Data framework for RAG: ingestion, indexes, query engines.
harnesses.summary_zh: RAG 数据框架：摄取、索引、查询引擎。

harnesses.name: LangChain
harnesses.summary_en: Framework for retrieval-augmented and agentic LLM apps.
harnesses.summary_zh: 检索增强与代理式 LLM 应用框架。

harnesses.name: FAISS
harnesses.summary_en: Efficient similarity search over dense vectors.
harnesses.summary_zh: 稠密向量的高效相似度检索。

harnesses.name: Qdrant
harnesses.summary_en: Vector database with payload filtering for RAG.
harnesses.summary_zh: 支持负载过滤的向量数据库，用于 RAG。

harnesses.name: Chroma
harnesses.summary_en: Embeddable vector store for retrieval applications.
harnesses.summary_zh: 可嵌入的向量存储，用于检索应用。

harnesses.name: sentence-transformers
harnesses.summary_en: Dense text embeddings for semantic search and retrieval.
harnesses.summary_zh: 用于语义检索的稠密文本嵌入。

harnesses.name: bm25s
harnesses.summary_en: Fast lexical BM25 retrieval (sparse baseline).
harnesses.summary_zh: 快速词法 BM25 检索（稀疏基线）。

harnesses.name: Trafilatura
harnesses.summary_en: Extract clean main text + metadata from web pages.
harnesses.summary_zh: 从网页抽取正文与元数据。

harnesses.name: Readability
harnesses.summary_en: Readability.js/parser: article extraction from HTML.
harnesses.summary_zh: Readability：从 HTML 提取文章正文。

harnesses.name: Jina Reader
harnesses.summary_en: URL -> clean LLM-ready markdown via r.jina.ai.
harnesses.summary_zh: URL → 供 LLM 使用的干净 Markdown（r.jina.ai）。

harnesses.name: Firecrawl
harnesses.summary_en: Crawl + scrape sites into clean structured data for LLMs.
harnesses.summary_zh: 抓取站点并为 LLM 输出干净结构化数据。

harnesses.name: Crawl4AI
harnesses.summary_en: Open-source LLM-friendly async web crawler.
harnesses.summary_zh: 开源、LLM 友好的异步网页爬虫。

harnesses.name: Rayyan
harnesses.summary_en: Systematic-review screening with collaborative inclusion/exclusion.
harnesses.summary_zh: 系统综述筛选，支持协作式纳入/排除。

harnesses.name: Covidence
harnesses.summary_en: PRISMA-aligned systematic-review workflow and screening.
harnesses.summary_zh: 对齐 PRISMA 的系统综述流程与筛选。

harnesses.name: ASReview
harnesses.summary_en: Active-learning tool to prioritize records in systematic reviews.
harnesses.summary_zh: 主动学习工具，优先排序系统综述记录。

harnesses.name: GAIA
harnesses.summary_en: General assistant benchmark with multi-hop, tool-using questions.
harnesses.summary_zh: 通用助手基准，含多跳、用工具的问题。

harnesses.name: BrowseComp
harnesses.summary_en: Benchmark for browsing agents: hard, hard-to-find facts.
harnesses.summary_zh: 浏览代理基准：困难、难找的事实。

harnesses.name: Humanity’s Last Exam
harnesses.summary_en: Frontier knowledge benchmark across expert domains.
harnesses.summary_zh: 跨专家领域的尖端知识基准。

harnesses.name: FRAMES
harnesses.summary_en: Retrieval + factuality benchmark over multi-document reasoning.
harnesses.summary_zh: 多文档推理的检索与事实性基准。

harnesses.name: DeepResearch Bench
harnesses.summary_en: Benchmark for deep-research reports (RACE/FACT metrics).
harnesses.summary_zh: 深度调研报告基准（RACE/FACT 指标）。

harnesses.name: Hermes Agent
harnesses.summary_en: Self-improving personal agent: agent-curated memory, autonomous skill creation, portable SKILL.md, and a multi-platform gateway.
harnesses.summary_zh: 自我改进的个人 agent：agent 自策展记忆、自主创建技能、可移植 SKILL.md、多平台网关。

harnesses.name: Agent Skills standard
harnesses.summary_en: Open, portable skill format: a directory with SKILL.md (name + description frontmatter) loaded by progressive disclosure across many agent clients.
harnesses.summary_zh: 开放可移植技能格式：含 SKILL.md（name+description 前言）的目录，按渐进披露在多客户端加载。

harnesses.name: OpenClaw
harnesses.summary_en: Local, open-source personal AI assistant; messaging-channel gateway plus Agent Skills.
harnesses.summary_zh: 本地开源个人 AI 助手；消息渠道网关 + Agent Skills。

harnesses.name: Letta Code
harnesses.summary_en: Stateful agent harness on the Letta platform: git-backed memory that learns and self-improves the agent.
harnesses.summary_zh: Letta 平台上的有状态 agent harness：git 支撑的记忆，agent 借此学习与自我改进。

harnesses.name: pi (pi-mono)
harnesses.summary_en: Minimal terminal coding harness; supports Agent Skills.
harnesses.summary_zh: 极简终端编码 harness；支持 Agent Skills。

harnesses.name: hermit (file-first)
harnesses.summary_en: File-first runtime for self-improving autonomous apps: heartbeat daemon, telemetry, strategic review, git checkpoints, and a sandbox.
harnesses.summary_zh: 自改进自治应用的文件优先运行时：心跳守护、遥测、战略复盘、git 检查点与沙箱。

harnesses.name: Lean 4
harnesses.summary_en: Theorem prover and programming language with a small trusted kernel; tactic-based automation.
harnesses.summary_zh: 定理证明器兼编程语言；可信内核小；以 tactic 做证明自动化。

harnesses.name: mathlib4
harnesses.summary_en: Community mathematical library for Lean 4; the substrate formalised mathematics builds on.
harnesses.summary_zh: Lean 4 社区数学库；形式化数学的主要底座。

harnesses.name: The Rocq Prover
harnesses.summary_en: Interactive theorem prover (formerly Coq); ACM Software System Award; mature proof libraries.
harnesses.summary_zh: 交互式定理证明器（原 Coq）；获 ACM 软件系统奖；证明库成熟。

harnesses.name: Isabelle
harnesses.summary_en: Generic proof assistant (Isabelle/HOL) with strong automation; Archive of Formal Proofs.
harnesses.summary_zh: 通用证明助手（Isabelle/HOL），自动化程度高；配套 Archive of Formal Proofs。

harnesses.name: Agda
harnesses.summary_en: Dependently typed language and interactive theorem prover: proofs are programs.
harnesses.summary_zh: 依赖类型语言与交互式定理证明器：证明即程序。

harnesses.name: Dafny
harnesses.summary_en: Verification-aware language: specifications and proofs discharged by an SMT backend; compiles to C#/Java/Go/Python.
harnesses.summary_zh: 验证感知语言：规格与证明交给 SMT 后端自动检查；可编译到 C#/Java/Go/Python。

harnesses.name: Z3
harnesses.summary_en: SMT solver widely used as the automation backend of verifiers and proof tooling.
harnesses.summary_zh: SMT 求解器；常作为验证器与证明工具链的自动化后端。

harnesses.name: cvc5
harnesses.summary_en: Open-source SMT solver; successor of CVC4, usable as a tool or a library.
harnesses.summary_zh: 开源 SMT 求解器；CVC4 的后继，可作独立工具或库调用。

harnesses.name: TLA+
harnesses.summary_en: Specification language (set theory + temporal logic) and the TLC model checker for concurrent designs.
harnesses.summary_zh: 规约语言（集合论 + 时序逻辑）与 TLC 模型检验器，用于并发/分布式设计。

harnesses.name: Alloy
harnesses.summary_en: Relational modelling language with bounded model finding (Kodkod); Alloy 6 adds mutable state and temporal logic.
harnesses.summary_zh: 关系建模语言与有界模型查找（Kodkod）；Alloy 6 加入可变状态与时序逻辑。

harnesses.name: Pint
harnesses.summary_en: Python physical-quantity library: define, convert and check units so dimensional errors surface at runtime.
harnesses.summary_zh: Python 物理量库：定义、换算并在运行时暴露量纲错误。

harnesses.name: uncertainties
harnesses.summary_en: Numbers with uncertainties ('x ± u'): automatic first-order error propagation and derivatives (GUM-style).
harnesses.summary_zh: 带不确定度的数值（x ± u）：自动一阶误差传播与求导（GUM 风格）。

harnesses.name: RDKit
harnesses.summary_en: Open-source cheminformatics: molecule parsing, canonicalisation, substructure search, descriptors.
harnesses.summary_zh: 开源化学信息学：分子解析、规范化、子结构检索与描述符计算。

harnesses.name: Biopython
harnesses.summary_en: Python toolkit for sequence/structure I/O (Bio.SeqIO, Bio.PDB) and BLAST/Entrez access.
harnesses.summary_zh: Python 序列与结构 I/O 工具包（Bio.SeqIO、Bio.PDB）及 BLAST/Entrez 接口。

harnesses.name: RCSB PDB
harnesses.summary_en: Primary archive of experimentally determined biomolecular structures (plus computed models); citable accession ids.
harnesses.summary_zh: 实验测定生物大分子结构的主归档（含计算模型）；条目有可引用编号。

harnesses.name: UniProt
harnesses.summary_en: Curated protein sequence and function resource; accessions carry reviewed/unreviewed status.
harnesses.summary_zh: 人工审编的蛋白序列与功能资源；登录号带审编状态。

harnesses.name: Universal Dependencies
harnesses.summary_en: Cross-linguistically consistent treebank annotation scheme, with released treebanks and validators.
harnesses.summary_zh: 跨语言一致的树库标注规范，并发布树库与校验工具。

harnesses.name: INCEpTION
harnesses.summary_en: Web annotation platform: multi-layer annotation, knowledge-base linking, machine-assisted suggestions.
harnesses.summary_zh: Web 标注平台：多层标注、知识库链接、机器辅助建议。

harnesses.name: ELAN
harnesses.summary_en: Annotation tool for audio/video recordings: tiered, time-aligned transcription stored as EAF/XML.
harnesses.summary_zh: 音视频标注工具：分层、时间对齐的转写，保存为 EAF/XML。

harnesses.name: PsychoPy
harnesses.summary_en: Experiment builder/runtime for behavioural studies (Builder GUI + Python); Pavlovia runs studies online.
harnesses.summary_zh: 行为实验的构建与运行时（Builder 图形界面 + Python）；Pavlovia 支持在线实验。

harnesses.name: jsPsych
harnesses.summary_en: JavaScript library for browser-based behavioural experiments.
harnesses.summary_zh: 用于浏览器行为实验的 JavaScript 库。

harnesses.name: OSF (Open Science Framework)
harnesses.summary_en: Registration/preregistration and project archive; hosts the registered-reports infrastructure.
harnesses.summary_zh: 注册/预注册与项目归档平台；承载注册报告（registered reports）流程。

harnesses.name: statsmodels
harnesses.summary_en: Python statistical modelling: linear/mixed models, diagnostics, multiple-comparison tooling, intervals.
harnesses.summary_zh: Python 统计建模：线性/混合模型、诊断、多重比较工具与区间估计。

harnesses.name: lme4
harnesses.summary_en: R mixed-effects models (lmer/glmer): the default for clustered behavioural and longitudinal data.
harnesses.summary_zh: R 混合效应模型（lmer/glmer）：集群化行为与纵向数据的常用默认。

harnesses.name: Stan
harnesses.summary_en: Probabilistic programming for Bayesian models (MCMC/HMC); reports intervals and posterior checks.
harnesses.summary_zh: 贝叶斯建模的概率编程语言（MCMC/HMC）；输出区间与后验检验。

harnesses.name: Snakemake
harnesses.summary_en: Python-based workflow management for reproducible, scalable analyses with per-rule provenance.
harnesses.summary_zh: 基于 Python 的工作流管理：可复现、可扩展的分析流程与逐规则溯源。

harnesses.name: Nextflow
harnesses.summary_en: Dataflow DSL for portable scalable pipelines: containers, resume/caching, native data lineage.
harnesses.summary_zh: 可移植可扩展流水线的数据流 DSL：容器、断点续跑/缓存、原生数据血缘。

harnesses.name: SageMath
harnesses.summary_en: Open-source CAS built on Python; unifies SymPy, GAP, PARI/GP, Singular and more.
harnesses.summary_zh: 基于 Python 的开源代数系统；整合 SymPy、GAP、PARI/GP、Singular 等。

harnesses.name: Singular
harnesses.summary_en: CAS for polynomial computations: commutative/non-commutative algebra and algebraic geometry.
harnesses.summary_zh: 面向多项式计算的代数系统：交换/非交换代数与代数几何。

harnesses.name: Macaulay2
harnesses.summary_en: System for research in algebraic geometry and commutative algebra (Groebner bases, resolutions).
harnesses.summary_zh: 面向代数几何与交换代数的系统（Gröbner 基、自由分解等）。

harnesses.name: GAP
harnesses.summary_en: System for computational discrete algebra, with emphasis on computational group theory.
harnesses.summary_zh: 计算离散代数系统，尤重计算群论。

harnesses.name: PARI/GP
harnesses.summary_en: CAS optimised for fast computations in number theory.
harnesses.summary_zh: 面向数论快速计算的代数系统。

harnesses.name: OSCAR
harnesses.summary_en: Julia-based CAS combining GAP, Singular and polymake for algebra, geometry and number theory.
harnesses.summary_zh: 基于 Julia 的代数系统，整合 GAP、Singular 与 polymake，覆盖代数、几何、数论。

harnesses.name: SymPy
harnesses.summary_en: Pure-Python library for symbolic mathematics; importable, scriptable, no external deps.
harnesses.summary_zh: 纯 Python 符号计算库；可导入、可脚本化、无外部依赖。

harnesses.name: CaDiCaL
harnesses.summary_en: Modern CDCL SAT solver, compact and easy to modify; good for incremental use.
harnesses.summary_zh: 现代 CDCL SAT 求解器，紧凑易改，适合增量求解。

harnesses.name: Mathematical Components
harnesses.summary_en: Coq/Rocq library of formalised mathematics (four-colour theorem, odd order theorem).
harnesses.summary_zh: Coq/Rocq 形式化数学库（四色定理、奇阶定理等）。

harnesses.name: Metamath
harnesses.summary_en: Minimal, flexible proof language with a tiny verifier; proof database checked step by step.
harnesses.summary_zh: 极简而灵活的证明语言与极小验证器；证明库逐步校验。

harnesses.name: CGAL
harnesses.summary_en: C++ library of efficient, reliable geometric algorithms (exact predicates, triangulations).
harnesses.summary_zh: 高效可靠几何算法的 C++ 库（精确谓词、三角剖分等）。

harnesses.name: GUDHI
harnesses.summary_en: C++/Python library for computational topology and topological data analysis (persistent homology).
harnesses.summary_zh: 计算拓扑与拓扑数据分析的 C++/Python 库（持续同调等）。

harnesses.name: Regina
harnesses.summary_en: Software for low-dimensional topology: 3/4-manifold triangulations, knots, normal surfaces.
harnesses.summary_zh: 低维拓扑软件：3/4 维流形三角剖分、纽结、正规曲面。

harnesses.name: SnapPy
harnesses.summary_en: Studies the topology and hyperbolic geometry of 3-manifolds (SnapPea).
harnesses.summary_zh: 研究三维流形的拓扑与双曲几何（SnapPea）。

harnesses.name: polymake
harnesses.summary_en: Research software for polyhedral geometry: polytopes, polyhedra, fans, simplicial complexes.
harnesses.summary_zh: 多面体几何研究软件：多胞形、多面体、扇、单纯复形。

harnesses.name: R
harnesses.summary_en: Free environment for statistical computing and graphics; the reference for applied statistics.
harnesses.summary_zh: 统计计算与图形的自由环境；应用统计的事实参照。

harnesses.name: PyMC
harnesses.summary_en: Probabilistic programming in Python: Bayesian models fitted by MCMC and variational inference.
harnesses.summary_zh: Python 概率编程：以 MCMC 与变分推断拟合贝叶斯模型。

harnesses.name: NumPyro
harnesses.summary_en: Bayesian inference on JAX: fast gradient-based MCMC and variational inference.
harnesses.summary_zh: 基于 JAX 的贝叶斯推断：快速梯度 MCMC 与变分推断。

harnesses.name: ArviZ
harnesses.summary_en: Exploratory analysis of Bayesian models: diagnostics (R-hat, ESS), comparison, visualisation.
harnesses.summary_zh: 贝叶斯模型探索性分析：诊断（R-hat、ESS）、比较与可视化。

harnesses.name: brms
harnesses.summary_en: R package fitting Bayesian multilevel models via Stan with lme4-style formula syntax.
harnesses.summary_zh: R 包：以 Stan 拟合贝叶斯多层模型，采用 lme4 风格公式语法。

harnesses.name: R-INLA
harnesses.summary_en: Fast approximate Bayesian inference for latent Gaussian models (integrated nested Laplace).
harnesses.summary_zh: 潜高斯模型的快速近似贝叶斯推断（集成嵌套拉普拉斯）。

harnesses.name: emcee
harnesses.summary_en: Pure-Python affine-invariant ensemble MCMC sampler ('the MCMC Hammer').
harnesses.summary_zh: 纯 Python 仿射不变集合 MCMC 采样器（“MCMC 之锤”）。

harnesses.name: DoWhy
harnesses.summary_en: Python library for causal inference: model, identify, estimate, refute -- assumptions first-class.
harnesses.summary_zh: Python 因果推断库：建模·辨识·估计·反驳——假设是主角。

harnesses.name: Protege
harnesses.summary_en: Reference open-source OWL editor with reasoner integration; ontology authoring and maintenance.
harnesses.summary_zh: 权威开源 OWL 编辑器；接推理机，做本体编写与维护。

harnesses.name: RDFLib
harnesses.summary_en: Python library for RDF/OWL/SHACL: parse, query (SPARQL) and validate a graph in-process.
harnesses.summary_zh: Python 的 RDF/OWL/SHACL 库：进程内解析、SPARQL 查询与校验。

harnesses.name: Apache Jena
harnesses.summary_en: Java RDF framework with SHACL validation and inference; the reference triple-store toolchain.
harnesses.summary_zh: Java 的 RDF 框架，含 SHACL 校验与推理；三元组库的标准工具链。

harnesses.name: Neo4j
harnesses.summary_en: Property-graph database with the Cypher query language; the usual store behind a served KG.
harnesses.summary_zh: 属性图数据库与 Cypher 查询语言；已建知识图谱常用的存储后端。

harnesses.name: Microsoft GraphRAG
harnesses.summary_en: Reference pipeline that builds an entity/relationship graph from text, clusters it and answers over community summaries.
harnesses.summary_zh: 从文本建实体—关系图、聚类、以社区摘要作答的参考实现。

harnesses.name: OpenRefine
harnesses.summary_en: Data-cleaning workbench whose reconciliation API maps messy values to canonical authority ids.
harnesses.summary_zh: 数据清洗工作台；其 reconciliation 协议把脏值映射到权威 ID。

harnesses.name: Splink
harnesses.summary_en: Probabilistic record linkage at scale (Fellegi-Sunter) with tunable match thresholds.
harnesses.summary_zh: 大规模概率式记录链接（Fellegi–Sunter），阈值可调。

harnesses.name: Dedupe
harnesses.summary_en: Interactive deduplication library: labels a few pairs, learns a matcher, applies it to the rest.
harnesses.summary_zh: 交互式去重库：人工标注少量样本，学习匹配器后批量应用。

harnesses.name: Pleiades
harnesses.summary_en: Citable, versioned gazetteer of the ancient world: stable URIs and recorded name variants.
harnesses.summary_zh: 可引用、带版本的古代世界地名表：稳定 URI 与异名记录。

harnesses.name: GeoNames
harnesses.summary_en: Place-name authority with stable geonameIds, hierarchies and reverse-geocoding APIs.
harnesses.summary_zh: 地名权威库：稳定 geonameId、层级关系与反向地理编码 API。

harnesses.name: Getty TGN
harnesses.summary_en: Thesaurus of Geographic Names: controlled vocabulary with place types, hierarchy and stable ids.
harnesses.summary_zh: 盖蒂地名表：受控词表，含地物类型、层级与稳定 ID。

harnesses.name: Transkribus
harnesses.summary_en: Handwritten-text recognition platform for historical documents; train or reuse public models.
harnesses.summary_zh: 历史文献手写识别平台；可训练或复用公开模型。

harnesses.name: eScriptorium
harnesses.summary_en: Open-source HTR and transcription platform built on Kraken; layout + text in one workflow.
harnesses.summary_zh: 基于 Kraken 的开源 HTR 与转写平台；版面与文本一体。

harnesses.name: Vale
harnesses.summary_en: Rule-based prose linter with configurable, style-guide-driven rules; enforces a declared house style instead of taste.
harnesses.summary_zh: 规则驱动的文稿 linter，可用房规（style guide）配置；以声明的风格规则取代个人口味。

harnesses.name: LanguageTool
harnesses.summary_en: Open-source grammar and style checker for many languages, Chinese included; catches agreement, punctuation and usage errors.
harnesses.summary_zh: 开源语法与风格检查器，支持多语种（含中文）；可查搭配、标点与用法错误。

harnesses.name: textstat
harnesses.summary_en: Readability metrics (Flesch-Kincaid, SMOG, Dale-Chall and others) as a drift alarm - advisory, never a pass mark.
harnesses.summary_zh: 可读性指标（Flesch-Kincaid、SMOG、Dale-Chall 等），只作漂移警报——仅供参考，绝不作通过标准。

harnesses.name: HermiT
harnesses.vendor: University of Oxford, Information Systems Group
harnesses.summary_en: OWL 2 DL reasoner; decides entailment and finds inconsistency, so an ontology claim can be refuted rather than asserted.
harnesses.summary_zh: OWL 2 DL 推理机；判定蕴含并发现不一致，使本体主张可被反驳而非仅被宣称。

harnesses.name: ELK
harnesses.summary_en: Consequence-based OWL 2 EL reasoner; fast classification for large terminologies where full DL is intractable.
harnesses.summary_zh: 基于后承的 OWL 2 EL 推理机；面向大规模术语体系，在完整 DL 不可行时仍可快速分类。

harnesses.name: Mermaid
harnesses.summary_en: Diagrams written as text and rendered on demand, so structure lives in a reviewable source and changes appear in a diff.
harnesses.summary_zh: 以文本描述图并即时渲染：结构存放在可复核的源码里，改动会出现在 diff 中。

harnesses.name: Vega-Lite
harnesses.summary_en: A grammar of interactive graphics: a chart is a specification over encodings, so the encoding - and what it hides - can be inspected and regenerated.
harnesses.summary_zh: 交互图形语法：图表是「编码」的声明式规格，因此编码（以及它所隐去的东西）可被检查与重生成。

harnesses.name: Mistral Agents API
harnesses.summary_en: Mistral's agents API: built-in connectors, code execution and guardrails for multi-step agent workflows.
harnesses.summary_zh: Mistral 的 agents API：内置连接器、代码执行与护栏的多步 agent 工作流。

harnesses.name: Hermit (Cash App)
harnesses.summary_en: Hermetic per-project toolchain manager; ships an AI-coding-agent skill for reproducible agent-managed repos.
harnesses.summary_zh: 逐项目封闭工具链管理器；附带 AI 编码 agent 技能，用于可复现的 agent 管理仓库。
